name: Devenzi Product Boxes
author: devenzi

sections.description:
Devenzi Product Boxes is for bloggers and review sites that recommend products. Instead of filling in forms and hoping the result looks good, you design your comparison right on the live preview: click any text to type, click any element to style it, drag products into order. What you see in the studio is exactly what your visitors get.

Designed on the live preview

  • Full-screen Creator Studio without admin clutter. You see your comparison, a panel for products and one for the look.
  • Type directly into the preview: product names, descriptions, highlights, pros and cons, prices, badges, column titles and button labels.
  • You can style every element: buttons (presets, colours, gradients, icons, sizes, “only this one”), badges, prices, stars, highlights and the colours of text and surfaces.
  • Save a button style or a whole look under My styles and reuse it in every comparison.
  • Undo and redo for every change, and a warning before you leave unsaved work.
  • Set up in one minute: a short setup asks for your Amazon partner tag, the look of new comparisons and how ads are labelled.

Six formats

Table, cards, carousel (arrows, dots, autoplay with a pause button, endless), podium for your top three, a single product box and a shop. Tables turn into cards on phones automatically.

A shop with filters

Show your whole product library as a shop, or just one category or chosen products. Visitors search, sort and filter by category, shop, price, rating and badge, with the number of hits next to every choice, and load more with one click. Everything is in the page’s HTML, so search engines can read it, and it works without JavaScript.

Single products and links in your text

  • Block “Affiliate product”: one product as a box, a compact row or just price and button.
  • Product links in the text: mark words in any paragraph and link them to a product of your library, with its price if you like. Change the link once in the library, and every text follows.
  • Shortcodes for every place outside the block editor.

Product finder

Put a few questions above any comparison, such as “What’s your budget?” or “Do you have pets?”. Visitors then get the products that fit them, with honest reasons: “Fits 3 of 3 answers”, plus what fits and what does not. The studio suggests first questions from your products, and a table shows which answer leads to which product. Without JavaScript, the finder reads as a guide with links to the products.

One product library

  • Each product is created once and used in any number of comparisons, boxes, shops and texts.
  • Several images as a slideshow, price and old price, your rating, highlights, pros and cons, a badge, a category, any shop link. An Amazon ASIN alone is enough too: the link with your partner tag is built for you.
  • Paste instead of typing: a list of shop links or ASINs, or a table from Excel or Google Sheets, turns into products. Products you already have are recognised.
  • A Products tab with filters for everything (what is missing, where a product is used, category, shop, price, rating, clicks, link check) and actions for many products at once.
  • Prices from shop feeds: add the product feeds your networks give you (AWIN, Google Shopping, any CSV), and linked shops take price, availability and link from them every night. The plugin suggests matches by EAN or name, but nothing is linked without your click. A feed without a good run for 48 hours shows no prices.

Link check

Dead links cost money. In the background, the plugin checks the shop links of your products about once a week and finds pages that are gone, links that end on a shop’s start page and affiliate networks that no longer forward. Broken links show up in the Products tab, and Replace everywhere puts another product into every comparison (with undo). Amazon pages are never fetched. The link check can be switched off.

Moving from AAWP or Lasso

Your products come over with one click, and products you already have are recognised. The old shortcodes [amazon …] and [lasso …] keep working once you switch the old plugin off, and its data stays untouched.

Made for the rules

  • Amazon-safe prices: Amazon allows its prices on other sites only through its interface. Without it, Amazon products automatically show “See price on Amazon” instead of a typed-in price, and no Amazon review counts. Your own stars are labelled as your own rating.
  • Ad labels at the element: “Ad” at every button or once on top, and at product links in the text, as German courts expect. The ad notice with Amazon’s required sentence is included too.
  • The price date stays honest. It changes only when a price changes or you confirm it, not with every edit.

Click statistics

See which products, comparisons and pages get clicks on your partner links. You get daily totals only, without cookies, IP addresses or device data, and nothing is sent to other services.

Built for real sites

  • One renderer for site and studio: clean, fast HTML with rel="sponsored" links.
  • Structured data (schema.org) for search engines, containing only what visitors see.
  • JavaScript only on pages that need it (carousel, slideshow, finder, shop, counting).
  • Works with the block editor and anywhere else with a shortcode.
  • Ready for translation; language packs come from translate.wordpress.org.

External services

Link check (your products’ shop links): to find dead links, your site opens the shop links of your products about once a week in the background (a HEAD request, if needed a short GET request, following up to five redirects). Only public addresses are opened, never Amazon pages. Nothing about your visitors is sent, only the request your server makes, with a user agent naming this plugin and your site’s address. The shops you link to receive these requests; their terms and privacy notices apply. You can switch this off under Settings → Link check; “Check now” in the Products tab still works then. Note: an affiliate network may count such a check as a click in its own statistics.

Amazon Creators API (only after you enter your Amazon credentials in the settings):

What it is and why the plugin uses it: the Creators API is Amazon’s official interface for members of the Amazon Associates program (the Product Advertising API is reached through it). Amazon allows prices, availability, titles and images of Amazon products on your site only as they come fresh from this API, so the plugin uses it to show these details in your comparisons and to check your credentials. Without credentials, no request goes to Amazon and Amazon products show without price.

  • Connection test (“Save and test connection”): to get an access token, your Credential ID and Credential Secret go to Amazon’s token service for your region (api.amazon.com, api.amazon.co.uk or api.amazon.co.jp; for older credentials of version 2.x creatorsapi.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com, creatorsapi.auth.eu-south-2.amazoncognito.com or creatorsapi.auth.us-west-2.amazoncognito.com). If Amazon does not recognise them there, the test asks the other two regions too, to tell a wrong region from wrong credentials. Then one product ID (ASIN), your partner tag and your marketplace go to the Creators API (creatorsapi.amazon).
  • Product data in the background (about once an hour, through WP-Cron): for the Amazon products in your library that are shown somewhere, their ASINs, your partner tag and your marketplace go to the Creators API (getItems); price, availability, title and image come back. Data older than about 50 minutes is refreshed, as Amazon asks.
  • Live lists (bestseller or keyword lists in a comparison): the keywords or the category you set, your partner tag and your marketplace go to the Creators API (searchItems) when the list is refreshed.

Nothing about your visitors is sent. This service is provided by Amazon: Creators API license, Amazon Associates Program Operating Agreement, Amazon privacy notice.

AWIN Publisher API, only after you enter your AWIN publisher ID and API token in the earnings settings (“AWIN commissions”): once a day your site asks api.awin.com for your commissions of the last days, with your publisher ID and token. Only your own transactions come back (amount, status, date, the click reference “sr” plus a page number that the plugin sets in your AWIN links). Nothing about your visitors is sent. AWIN’s terms and privacy notice apply: AWIN publisher terms, AWIN privacy notice.

Price feeds of affiliate networks, only for feeds you add under Feeds: your site downloads each feed from the address you entered (for example a product feed of AWIN, Adcell or a shop), in the background, checked once an hour, and stores the prices in its own table. The address often carries your network key; it is sent only to that address. Nothing about your visitors is sent. The network’s or shop’s terms apply.

Product images are loaded by your visitors’ browsers from the address you enter for each image. If that address belongs to another site (for example an Amazon image server), the visitor’s browser connects to it, like with any embedded image.

When a visitor clicks a partner link, they leave your site for the shop (Amazon or any other shop you link to), and that shop’s terms and privacy notice apply.

Privacy

  • Click statistics (on by default, can be switched off): when a visitor clicks a partner link in a comparison, or when the product finder shows a result, the browser sends a short request to your own site. Stored are daily totals per product, comparison and page: no IP address, no device data, no cookies, nothing stored in the browser, nothing sent to other services. Totals are deleted after 400 days. Your own clicks are not counted while you are logged in.
  • Only count with consent: supports the WP Consent API (category “statistics-anonymous”) or a signal from any consent tool (window.devenziProductBoxesConsent = true).
  • A suggested text for your privacy policy is added under Settings → Privacy in WordPress.
  • The plugin sets no cookies and stores nothing in your visitors’ browsers.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through Plugins → Add New or upload the ZIP, then activate it.
  2. Open Product Boxes in the admin menu and click Set up in one minute (partner tag, look, ad label). A demo comparison is already there.
  3. Add products by hand or paste a list of links, ASINs or a table.
  4. Create a comparison and design it in the studio. Add it to a page with the “Product Boxes” block, or paste the shortcode shown under Embed. For a single product, use the “Affiliate product” block.
sections.faq:
Do I need the Amazon API?

No. You can enter every product by hand, with any shop link. With only an ASIN, the plugin builds the Amazon link with your partner tag. Credentials for the Amazon Creators API are optional; the settings include a connection test.

Live Amazon data (prices, availability, images, Amazon search lists) is in beta. It is built to Amazon’s official SDK and documentation, but has not been tried with many accounts yet. Amazon unlocks product data only for Associates accounts with at least 10 qualifying sales in the last 30 days in that marketplace. Until then, or if anything goes wrong, Amazon products show “See price on Amazon”, and the connection test tells you why.

Why does an Amazon product show “See price on Amazon” instead of my price?

Amazon’s rules allow Amazon prices on other sites only when they come from Amazon’s interface (Creators API) or from a link Amazon serves. Prices typed in by hand break those rules, so the plugin does not show them for Amazon products. Your price still sorts the products and answers the finder’s budget question. Products from other shops show your prices as usual.

Does the plugin open Amazon pages?

No. The link check never fetches Amazon pages, not even behind short links or cloaked links. Amazon links will be checked through the Amazon interface.

Can I use shops other than Amazon?

Yes. Every product can link anywhere. The partner tag is only added to Amazon links that do not have one yet.

Does it slow down my site?

Pages get a small stylesheet. JavaScript is only loaded where it is needed (for the carousel, image slideshows, the product finder and click counting), and it is loaded deferred.

Is the click statistics GDPR-compliant?

The plugin stores only daily totals per product, comparison and page. It uses no cookies, stores nothing in the browser, keeps no IP address or device data and sends nothing to other services. Whether you need consent depends on how your site is run and on your jurisdiction; that decision is yours as the site owner. If you want to count only with consent, switch on “Only count with consent”. It works with the WP Consent API, or with your consent tool setting window.devenziProductBoxesConsent = true. You can also switch counting off completely.

Can I measure the product finder with my own analytics?

Yes. The finder sends the JavaScript event devenzi-product-boxes:finder on every step (with the step, the answers so far and, at the end, the products shown). The plugin itself does not listen to it. Connect it to your own analytics tool, with your visitors’ consent where required.

What happens to my data if I delete the plugin?

By default your comparisons, products and settings stay, so they are back if you install the plugin again. Your Amazon and AWIN access data and your price feeds are always deleted, because they contain keys. As long as the plugin is gone, your pages show no comparisons, and product links in your text show as plain words. If you switch on “Remove everything when the plugin is deleted” in the settings, all comparisons, products, settings and statistics are deleted with the plugin.
sections.changelog:
0.1.0

  • First version: Creator Studio, six formats (table, cards, carousel, podium, box, shop), product finder, product library with categories and a Products tab, single products and text links, paste lists, link check, Amazon-safe prices, ad labels, structured data, setup, my styles, click statistics, Amazon connection test.
